# Shift Handover — Ring Rolling Line (see SOP-P2-L2-04)

Purpose: quick and clear transfer of responsibility between shifts for safe, continuous operation of the ring rolling line.

Current job and status
- Part program and work order on the HMI; ring size and material noted in the log.  
- Stage of operation and remaining process steps described; next shift to confirm first production piece meets acceptance criteria.

Machine and tooling
- Tooling installed and secured; tag any worn inserts and log expected replacements per tooling plan.  
- Lubrication and coolant levels checked at start of shift; report any abnormal consumption or contamination.

Material and inventory
- Incoming stock location and batch ID recorded; leftover blanks quarantined if out of spec.  
- Finished rings staged in the designated area with routing cards attached.

Quality and alarms
- Record of any alarms or process deviations with time, operator, and corrective action taken.  
- First piece inspection completed and any rework or scrap disposition logged.

Safety and housekeeping
- Lockout/tagout status for equipment under maintenance; no active LOTO without supervisor clearance.  
- Clear all walkways and ensure guarding is in place before starting.

Maintenance and follow up
- Any pending maintenance requests or parts on order noted for next shift.  
- Recommended start actions for next operator are listed; escalate unresolved issues to the line supervisor immediately.

Signatures: outgoing operator and incoming operator to acknowledge handover per SOP-P2-L2-04.
